name: Sakurazaka Meguru
source:
Goes to the same school as the main character. She is a girl who has transferred into the same class at the same school as the main character.

She likes the main character, but she has many romantic rivals, and she is quite impatient inwardly.

She has a strong competitive spirit, Especially against the chairman of the public morals committee.

She is good at making bombshell statements.

[From [url=http://www.teck.co.jp/gj/products/q_bon/chara/gense.html]official site[/url]]
